Our extraordinary Technical Support and Customer Service is one of the main reasons why our clients rate GlobalHostia as number one.

  • How can I order a new hosting plan?
  • What is reseller hosting?
  • How do I register a new domain?

  • Is your hosting secure?

  • VPS vs Dedicated Servers?
  • Do you offer money-back guarantee?
  • How can I order a new hosting plan?

    Ordering is simple! Browse our hosting plans, select the one that fits your needs, and click "Get Started Now". You'll be guided through our secure checkout process where you can configure your plan, register or transfer a domain, and complete payment.

    After payment confirmation, your hosting account will be provisioned within 5-15 minutes. You'll receive login credentials and setup instructions via email.

  • What is reseller hosting?

    Reseller hosting allows you to create and sell your own hosting packages under your brand. You get a master cPanel account with WHM (Web Host Manager) control panel, allowing you to allocate resources, create custom packages, and manage multiple client accounts.

    Perfect for web designers, developers, or entrepreneurs wanting to start their own hosting business without infrastructure investment. We handle the hardware, network, and technical support.

  • How do I register a new domain name?

    Use our domain search tool on the homepage to check availability. Enter your desired domain name (e.g., "yourbusiness.com"), and we'll show you available extensions with pricing. Popular TLDs include .com ($13.99), .net ($11.29), and .org ($8.99).

    Domains can be registered standalone or bundled with hosting plans. All domains include free WHOIS privacy protection, DNS management, and email forwarding.

  • What payment methods do you accept?

    We accept all major payment methods: Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, JCB, Maestro, Discover), PayPal for secure online payments, and Cryptocurrency (Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT) for digital currency transactions.

    All payments are processed through secure, PCI-DSS compliant gateways. Recurring subscriptions can be set up with cards or PayPal for automatic renewal.

  • Is your hosting secure?

    Absolutely! Security is our top priority. All plans include free SSL certificates, automated daily backups with 30-day retention, advanced DDoS protection, malware scanning, and server-level firewalls. Our datacenters feature 24/7 security monitoring and biometric access controls.

    We also provide automatic software updates, isolated account architecture, and compliance with ISO 27001 and SOC 2 standards.

  • Can you help me set up WordPress?

    Yes! Our Managed WordPress hosting starting at $12.99/month includes one-click installation, pre-configured optimization, automatic updates, and WordPress-specific caching. Your site will be online in minutes with zero technical knowledge required.

    We also offer staging environments, automatic malware removal, expert WordPress support, and pre-installed popular plugins. Our team can assist with migrations and theme setup.

  • How can I contact support?

    Our expert support team is available 24/7/365 via Live Chat (instant response), Email Support (sales@globalhostia.com with <2 hour response time), Phone Support at (+971) 50-7341578, and comprehensive Knowledge Base with guides.

    Premium customers receive priority support with dedicated account managers. We also maintain active social media channels for updates.

  • What's the difference between VPS and Dedicated Servers?

    VPS (Virtual Private Server) provides isolated resources on a shared physical server, starting at $8/month. You get guaranteed CPU, RAM, and storage with root access. Ideal for growing websites or applications needing dedicated resources.

    Dedicated Servers ($39.99+/month) give you an entire physical server exclusively. You get maximum performance, complete hardware control, and full customization from OS to security. Perfect for high-traffic sites or resource-intensive applications.

  • Do you offer a money-back guarantee?

    Yes! We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all shared hosting and WordPress hosting plans. If you're not completely satisfied within the first 30 days, contact our support team for a full refund—no questions asked.

    VPS and Dedicated Server plans include a 7-day money-back guarantee. Domain registrations and SSL certificates are non-refundable as per industry standards.

How can I order a new hosting plan?

Ordering is simple! Browse our hosting plans, select the one that fits your needs, and click "Get Started Now". You'll be guided through our secure checkout process where you can configure your plan, register or transfer a domain, and complete payment.

After payment confirmation, your hosting account will be provisioned within 5-15 minutes. You'll receive login credentials and setup instructions via email.

What is reseller hosting?

Reseller hosting allows you to create and sell your own hosting packages under your brand. You get a master cPanel account with WHM (Web Host Manager) control panel, allowing you to allocate resources, create custom packages, and manage multiple client accounts.

Perfect for web designers, developers, or entrepreneurs wanting to start their own hosting business without infrastructure investment. We handle the hardware, network, and technical support while you focus on growing your client base.

How do I register a new domain name?

Use our domain search tool on the homepage to check availability. Enter your desired domain name (e.g., "yourbusiness.com"), and we'll show you available extensions with pricing. Popular TLDs include .com ($13.99), .net ($11.29), .org ($8.99), and many more.

Domains can be registered standalone or bundled with hosting plans. All domains include free WHOIS privacy protection, DNS management, and email forwarding. Domain transfers from other registrars are also supported with competitive pricing.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept all major payment methods for your convenience: Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, JCB, Maestro, Discover), PayPal for secure online payments, and Cryptocurrency (Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT) for those preferring digital currency transactions.

All payments are processed through secure, PCI-DSS compliant gateways. Recurring subscriptions can be set up with cards or PayPal for automatic renewal, ensuring uninterrupted service.

Is your hosting secure?

Absolutely! Security is our top priority. All plans include free SSL certificates, automated daily backups with 30-day retention, advanced DDoS protection, malware scanning, and server-level firewalls. Our datacenters feature 24/7 security monitoring, biometric access controls, and redundant power systems.

We also provide automatic software updates, isolated account architecture to prevent cross-contamination, and compliance with industry standards including ISO 27001 and SOC 2. Your data is safe with us.

Can you help me set up WordPress?

Yes! Our Managed WordPress hosting starting at $12.99/month includes one-click installation, pre-configured optimization, automatic updates, and WordPress-specific caching. Your site will be online in minutes with zero technical knowledge required.

We also offer premium features like staging environments, automatic malware removal, expert WordPress support, and pre-installed popular plugins. For custom requirements, our support team can assist with migrations, theme setup, and plugin configuration.

How can I contact support?

Our expert support team is available 24/7/365 via multiple channels: Live Chat (instant response during business hours), Email Support (support@globalhostia.com with <2 hour response time), Phone Support at (+971) 50-7341578, and comprehensive Knowledge Base with guides and tutorials.

Premium and Enterprise customers receive priority support with dedicated account managers. We also maintain active social media channels for general inquiries and updates.

What's the difference between VPS and Dedicated Servers?

VPS (Virtual Private Server) provides isolated resources on a shared physical server, starting at $8/month. You get guaranteed CPU, RAM, and storage with root access and full control. Ideal for growing websites, development environments, or applications needing dedicated resources without full server costs.

Dedicated Servers ($39.99+/month) give you an entire physical server exclusively for your use. You get maximum performance, complete hardware control, and can customize everything from OS to security configurations. Perfect for high-traffic sites, resource-intensive applications, or businesses requiring complete isolation and maximum power.

Do you offer money-back guarantee?

Yes! We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all shared hosting and WordPress hosting plans. If you're not completely satisfied within the first 30 days, contact our support team for a full refund—no questions asked.

VPS and Dedicated Server plans include a 7-day money-back guarantee due to resource allocation commitments. Domain registrations and SSL certificates are non-refundable as per industry standards, but we'll work with you to ensure complete satisfaction with your hosting experience.

Can I upgrade my hosting plan later?

Absolutely! You can upgrade anytime from your client portal. Moving from shared to VPS, VPS to dedicated, or increasing resources within the same tier is seamless. We'll migrate your data at no extra charge, and you only pay the prorated difference for the remaining billing cycle.

Upgrades typically complete within 2-4 hours with zero downtime. Our migration team handles all technical aspects including DNS updates, file transfers, and database migrations. Downgrading is also possible, though subject to resource availability verification.

What control panel do you provide?

We provide cPanel/WHM, the industry's most popular and user-friendly control panel. It includes one-click app installer (Softaculous) with 400+ applications, email management, file manager, database tools (phpMyAdmin), FTP accounts, backup management, and comprehensive statistics.

VPS and Dedicated customers can choose alternative panels like DirectAdmin, Plesk, or custom configurations. All control panels are updated regularly and include SSL management, security tools, and mobile-responsive interfaces for management on the go.

Do you provide website migration services?

Yes! We offer FREE website migration for all hosting plans. Our migration specialists will transfer your website, emails, databases, and files from your current host with zero downtime. Simply provide your old hosting credentials, and we handle everything.

Migrations typically complete within 24-48 hours. We perform thorough testing before switching DNS to ensure everything works perfectly. For complex sites or enterprise migrations, we offer white-glove migration services with dedicated project managers and guaranteed SLAs.

Domain FAQ:

What is a domain name and why do I need one?

Domain names are created to make IP addresses easy to remember. Every computer has an IP address assigned to it — much like a street address. But instead of having to memorize each IP address number, we assign domain names to these numbers so we can easily remember them. The domain name system, or DNS, takes domain names and translates them into their IP addresses so that computers can communicate with one another. Coodiv cloud can help you find a domain name that best suits your business so you can easily promote your website.

What is domain name registration?

Domain name registration is the process of finding a web address (like Coodiv cloud.com or LilysBikes.com), and then signing up to use it. You technically don't own the domain, but once you've registered it, it's yours alone for as long as you continue paying the annual registration fee.

How do I buy domain names?

Here are the steps to buy domains:

  • Decide on a domain name extension. The extension is the part at the end of the domain name — .net, .biz, .org or .com, for example.
  • Think about what business name or specialty you'd like on the other side of the dot. Use our business name generator to find the right one.
  • Type the domain you want into the box at the top of this page. We'll tell you if that particular domain is available and also show you others you may like better.
  • Pick a domain, add it to your cart, and check out. You are now the proud owner of your very own domain. As long as it's registered to you, no one else may use it.
How long does my domain name registration last? How do I renew my domain?

How long your domain registration lasts can vary depending on the domain you purchase. Many domain name registrars will allow customers to register domains for 10 years at a time, but typically customers will register domains for one to three years.

If you want to extend your registration, it's easy to renew your domain with Coodiv cloud. You can choose to manually renew or set up auto-renewal, so you ensure it stays registered to you.

How do I get a free domain name?

Purchase an annual Web Hosting plan or any annual Managed WordPress plan by Coodiv cloud and you'll automatically qualify for a free domain.

Once you click Add to Cart for a hosting or WordPress plan, you'll be given the option to select monthly or annual terms. Make sure to choose an annual term if you want to get the free domain.

Click Continue with These Options at the bottom of the page to move on to the next step. This is where you'll see a search bar to look for the domain name you want.

Once you've found the name you want, just add the domain to your cart and continue to checkout.

What are bare metal servers?

Coodiv Clouds Dedicated Server Hosting offers bare metal servers, a single-tenant physical server that is not shared between users, meaning there’s no virtualization technology built-in; the customer is the only one (i.e., “dedicated”) to that server. That allows the user deep-server access, complete control and state-of-the-art hardware/software and flexible server configurations — including SSD and HDD storage options for specific hosting needs.

What is PCI compliance?

The Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards (PCI-DSS or PCI for short) designates security standards to protect cardholders’ credit card data. How can I accept credit cards online?

Website Security, Backups & Pro Emails FAQs:

What makes Website Security so simple?

Website Security lets you set up your site’s security scanning frequency, install your SSL Certificate and monitor your site for malware and other online security threats — all from one dashboard.

Where can I find my SSL Certificate?

Your SSL Certificate is built into the Web Application Firewall (WAF) that’s included with Website Security.

If I have an SSL Certificate, do I still need Website Security?

Yes — while an SSL certificate encrypts data being transmitted to and from your website, it doesn’t protect your site from other vulnerabilities, such as malware, SQL injections or DDoS attacks. By utilizing both an SSL and Website Security, you are taking steps to help protect more aspects of your site.

How often does Website Security scan my site for malware?

Depending on your Website Security Suites plan, you can choose from a 30-minute, 12-hour or once-a-day security monitoring and scan frequency. If any malware is found, you’ll be notified immediately.

How does a Web Application Firewall (WAF) secure my site?

A WAF is a cloud-based firewall service that screens and helps protect your real-time website traffic from threats like SQL injection attacks (malicious data that essentially tricks your site into doing something it shouldn’t) and DDoS attacks (crashes your site by overwhelming it with a flood of automated traffic). WAF only takes a few minutes to set up and is the front-line defense for your site in between Website Security scans.

How does the Content Delivery Network (CDN) speed up my site?

A CDN is a network of servers around the world that deploy dynamic and static caching so that all content will render quickly and reliably. For example, if someone in Japan visits your site that’s hosted in the US, it’ll load just as quickly as a website hosted in Japan.

What type of file transfer do you use?

We use FTP or SFTP depending on your host server. If your website is hosted with GoDaddy, we can automatically set up the FTP/SFTP connection for you.

Does Website Backup work with other web hosts?

Yes. Website Backup is platform agnostic and compatible with any hosting provider.

Does Website Backup provide security?

Yes, Website Backup encrypts all files, folders and databases that are transferred and stored. In addition, Website Backup provides a daily malware scan, continuous security monitoring and reputation monitoring.

How does scheduled backup work?

In the Website Backup dashboard, you can select daily, weekly or monthly backup, as well as backup start time.

Privacy Policy

Effective Date: January 1, 2024 | Last Updated: May 8, 2026

1. Introduction

Welcome to GlobalHostia. We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how GlobalHostia ("we," "us," or "our") collects, uses, discloses, and safeguards your information when you use our web hosting services, dedicated servers, VPS servers, domain registration, SSL certificates, and other web services (collectively, the "Services").

This policy applies globally and complies with applicable data protection regulations including the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), UK GDPR, UAE Data Protection Law, Saudi Arabia Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL), Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA) where applicable, India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA), and other international privacy frameworks.

If you have any questions or concerns about this policy or our data practices, please contact us at support@globalhostia.com.

2. Information We Collect

2.1 Personal Information You Provide

We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide when registering for our Services:

  • Account Information: Name, email address, phone number, company name, billing address
  • Payment Information: Credit/debit card details, billing information, payment method preferences (processed securely through third-party payment processors)
  • Domain Registration Data: Domain contact information (registrant, administrative, technical, and billing contacts) as required by ICANN and domain registries
  • Identity Verification: Government-issued ID, business registration documents (when required for compliance or high-value services)
  • Communication Data: Support tickets, live chat messages, emails, and any other correspondence with our team

2.2 Information Automatically Collected

When you access our Services, we automatically collect certain information:

  • Technical Data: IP address, browser type and version, operating system, device type, screen resolution
  • Usage Data: Pages visited, time spent on pages, click patterns, referral URLs, access times and dates
  • Server Logs: Access logs, error logs, bandwidth usage, resource consumption metrics
  • Cookies and Similar Technologies: Session cookies, persistent cookies, web beacons, pixel tags (see Section 8 for details)

2.3 Information from Third Parties

We may receive information about you from:

  • Payment processors and financial institutions
  • Fraud prevention and security service providers
  • Domain registries and registrars
  • Marketing and analytics partners
  • Public databases and WHOIS information

3. How We Use Your Information

We process your personal information for the following purposes:

3.1 Service Delivery and Account Management

  • Provision and management of hosting services, servers, and domains
  • Processing payments and managing billing cycles
  • Account creation, authentication, and security
  • Customer support and technical assistance
  • Service upgrades, renewals, and modifications

3.2 Legal and Regulatory Compliance

  • Compliance with ICANN domain registration requirements
  • Anti-money laundering (AML) and know-your-customer (KYC) obligations
  • Tax reporting and financial record-keeping
  • Response to legal requests, court orders, and regulatory inquiries
  • Enforcement of our Terms of Service and Acceptable Use Policy

3.3 Security and Fraud Prevention

  • Detection and prevention of fraudulent transactions
  • Monitoring for security threats, abuse, and unauthorized access
  • Investigation of Terms of Service violations
  • Protection of our infrastructure and customer data

3.4 Business Operations and Improvement

  • Analytics to improve service quality and user experience
  • Development of new features and services
  • Performance monitoring and capacity planning
  • Market research and customer satisfaction surveys

3.5 Marketing and Communications (With Your Consent)

  • Sending promotional emails about new services, features, and special offers
  • Service-related notifications and important updates
  • Newsletter subscriptions (you may opt-out at any time)
  • Targeted advertising based on your preferences

4. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR & International Compliance)

Under GDPR and similar regulations, we process your personal data based on the following legal grounds:

  • Contractual Necessity: Processing necessary to perform our contract with you (service delivery, billing, support)
  • Legal Obligation: Compliance with laws, regulations, and legal processes (ICANN requirements, tax laws, AML/KYC)
  • Legitimate Interests: Fraud prevention, security monitoring, business analytics, service improvement (balanced against your rights)
  • Consent: Marketing communications, optional cookies, and other processing activities requiring explicit consent
  • Vital Interests: Protection of your or another person's vital interests in emergency situations

5. Data Sharing and Disclosure

We may share your information with the following categories of recipients:

5.1 Service Providers and Processors

  • Payment processors (Stripe, PayPal, and other payment gateways)
  • Data center and infrastructure providers
  • Email service providers and communication platforms
  • Customer support and ticketing systems
  • Analytics and monitoring services
  • Security and fraud prevention services

5.2 Domain Registries and ICANN

For domain registration services, we are required to share registrant contact information with domain registries and make certain information publicly available through WHOIS databases, in accordance with ICANN policies. This may include name, organization, email address, phone number, and physical address.

5.3 Legal and Regulatory Authorities

We may disclose your information when required by law or in response to:

  • Court orders, subpoenas, or legal processes
  • Requests from law enforcement or government agencies
  • National security or public safety requirements
  • Regulatory investigations or inquiries

5.4 Business Transfers

In the event of a merger, acquisition, reorganization, bankruptcy, or sale of assets, your personal information may be transferred to the successor entity. We will notify you of any such change and provide information about your choices.

5.5 With Your Consent

We may share your information with third parties when you have provided explicit consent for such sharing.

6. International Data Transfers

GlobalHostia operates globally and may transfer your personal information to countries outside your country of residence, including countries that may not provide the same level of data protection as your home country.

When we transfer personal data from the European Economic Area (EEA), UK, or Switzerland to countries without an adequacy decision, we implement appropriate safeguards such as:

  • Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission
  • Binding Corporate Rules where applicable
  • Adherence to international data transfer frameworks and certifications
  • Additional technical and organizational security measures

For MENA region customers, we comply with local data residency requirements where applicable and ensure appropriate legal mechanisms are in place for cross-border data transfers.

7. Data Retention

We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

Retention Periods:

  • Active Account Data: Retained for the duration of your account relationship plus applicable legal requirements
  • Billing and Transaction Records: Minimum 7 years for tax and accounting purposes (may vary by jurisdiction)
  • Domain Registration Records: As required by ICANN policies and registry requirements (typically 2 years post-expiration)
  • Communication Records: 3-5 years for customer service quality and dispute resolution
  • Server Logs and Technical Data: 30-90 days unless needed for security investigations or legal compliance
  • Marketing Data: Until you withdraw consent or we determine the data is no longer necessary

After the retention period expires, we will securely delete or anonymize your personal information. Some information may be retained in aggregated or anonymized form for analytical purposes.

8. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

We use cookies, web beacons, and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience and collect usage information.

8.1 Types of Cookies We Use:

  • Essential Cookies: Necessary for website functionality, authentication, and security (cannot be disabled)
  • Performance Cookies: Collect anonymous analytics about site usage and performance
  • Functional Cookies: Remember your preferences and personalize your experience
  • Marketing Cookies: Track your browsing for targeted advertising (requires consent in certain jurisdictions)

8.2 Cookie Management:

You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings. Note that disabling certain cookies may limit website functionality. Most browsers allow you to:

  • View, delete, and block cookies
  • Set preferences for specific websites
  • Enable "Do Not Track" signals

For detailed information about cookies and how to manage them, visit www.allaboutcookies.org.

9. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information:

9.1 GDPR Rights (EU/EEA/UK Residents):

  • Right of Access: Request copies of your personal data
  • Right to Rectification: Correct inaccurate or incomplete information
  • Right to Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten"): Request deletion of your personal data (subject to legal exceptions)
  • Right to Restriction: Limit how we use your data
  • Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
  • Right to Object: Object to processing based on legitimate interests or for direct marketing
  • Right to Withdraw Consent: Withdraw consent at any time (without affecting lawfulness of prior processing)
  • Right to Lodge a Complaint: File a complaint with your local data protection authority

9.2 UAE & MENA Region Rights:

  • Access and review your personal data
  • Request correction of inaccurate information
  • Request deletion (subject to legal and regulatory obligations)
  • Object to processing for marketing purposes
  • Request information about data processing activities

9.3 India DPDPA Rights:

  • Right to access information about personal data processing
  • Right to correction and erasure
  • Right to data portability
  • Right to withdraw consent
  • Right to nominate another individual to exercise rights in case of death or incapacity

9.4 How to Exercise Your Rights:

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at support@globalhostia.com with the subject line "Privacy Rights Request." We will respond to your request within the timeframe required by applicable law (typically 30 days for GDPR requests).

We may require identity verification to protect your information from unauthorized access. Please note that certain rights may be subject to legal limitations and exceptions.

10. Security Measures

We implement comprehensive technical, organizational, and physical security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, and destruction.

Our Security Measures Include:

  • Encryption: TLS/SSL encryption for data in transit; AES-256 encryption for sensitive data at rest
  • Access Controls: Role-based access control (RBAC), multi-factor authentication (MFA), least privilege principle
  • Network Security: Firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, DDoS protection
  • Monitoring: 24/7 security monitoring, automated threat detection, regular security audits
  • Physical Security: Secured data centers with biometric access controls and environmental monitoring
  • Vendor Management: Due diligence and security assessments of third-party service providers
  • Incident Response: Documented incident response procedures and breach notification protocols
  • Employee Training: Regular security awareness training and confidentiality agreements

While we strive to protect your information, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security but continuously work to enhance our security posture.

11. Data Breach Notification

In the event of a personal data breach that is likely to result in a risk to your rights and freedoms, we will:

  • Notify the relevant supervisory authority without undue delay (within 72 hours where required by GDPR)
  • Notify affected individuals without undue delay if the breach poses a high risk
  • Provide clear information about the nature of the breach, likely consequences, and mitigation measures
  • Document all breaches and remediation actions taken

We maintain detailed incident response procedures to ensure prompt and effective handling of any security incidents.

12. Children's Privacy

Our Services are not intended for individuals under the age of 18 (or the applicable age of majority in your jurisdiction). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

If we become aware that we have collected personal information from a child without proper parental consent, we will take steps to delete such information promptly. If you believe we have collected information from a child, please contact us immediately at support@globalhostia.com.

13. Third-Party Links and Services

Our website and Services may contain links to third-party websites, applications, or services that are not operated by us. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these third parties.

We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party services you access through our platform. This Privacy Policy applies solely to information collected by GlobalHostia.

14. MiCA Compliance (Crypto-Assets)

Where our Services involve crypto-asset services subject to the EU Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA), we ensure compliance with applicable requirements including:

  • Enhanced customer due diligence and KYC procedures
  • Transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting
  • Segregation and protection of client crypto-assets
  • Transparent disclosure of fees and risks
  • Secure custody arrangements for digital assets

Additional privacy measures apply to crypto-asset transactions to ensure confidentiality while maintaining regulatory compliance.

15. Marketing Communications and Opt-Out

With your consent, we may send you promotional emails about new services, special offers, and other information we think may interest you.

You can opt-out of marketing communications at any time by:

  • Clicking the "unsubscribe" link in any marketing email
  • Updating your communication preferences in your account settings
  • Contacting us at support@globalhostia.com

Note: Opting out of marketing communications does not affect transactional emails related to your account, services, or legal obligations.

16. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technologies, legal requirements, or other factors. We will notify you of any material changes by:

  • Posting the updated policy on our website with a new "Last Updated" date
  • Sending email notifications for significant changes (where required by law)
  • Displaying a prominent notice on our website or within our Services

Your continued use of our Services after the effective date of the revised Privacy Policy constitutes acceptance of the changes. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

17. Contact Information and Data Protection Officer

If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:

GlobalHostia

Email: support@globalhostia.com

Data Protection Officer: dpo@globalhostia.com

Privacy Rights Requests: privacy@globalhostia.com

We aim to respond to all legitimate requests within 30 days. If your request is particularly complex or you have made multiple requests, we may extend this period and will notify you accordingly.

18. Supervisory Authority Contact

If you are located in the EU/EEA or UK and believe we have not adequately addressed your privacy concerns, you have the right to lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority:

  • EU/EEA: Contact your national Data Protection Authority (find your DPA)
  • UK: Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) - ico.org.uk
  • UAE: UAE Data Office - For data protection matters in the UAE
  • Saudi Arabia: Saudi Data & AI Authority (SDAIA) - For PDPL compliance matters
